items.title: The team's autos spin in the simulator (TITAN-1)
items.brief: For a TeleOp the simulator learns how the drive motors are mounted from what the code does with the stick (jvDriveFrom in src/jvmrun.js). For an Autonomous it skips that and buildRig in src/sim.js assumes a standard build, so a robot whose code sets all four wheels REVERSE turns on the spot. Make an Autonomous take its drive from the TeleOp it preselects (preselectTeleOp), else from a TeleOp among its siblings that drives the same motors, else from its own setDirection flags read as 'positive power is forward', and only then the standard build. Say in mountFrom which it was. Evidence and trace: the hub's robots/meet0/check-code.mjs and OPERATION_TITAN.md.
done_when: a test: a park auto with all four wheels REVERSE leaves its wall and holds its heading, and fails before the change

items.title: A part named "controller" is not a wheel (CAD-2)
items.brief: solidKind (src/hull.js about line 134) matches "roller" with no word boundary and before electronics and belts, so Core Motor Controller, Logitech F310 Controller and Roller Chain are wheels; the robot frame is then built on electronics boxes (a real 2016 robot ends 483 mm under its own floor) and chains weigh 7 times too much. Test electronics (controller, hub, module, board) and belt or chain before wheels; a word-bounded roller not followed by chain. dtOnFloor (src/drivetrain.js about 325): with fewer than two wheels level, return none so the bbox floor is used and said. robotFrame: if more than 2 % of points end below -10 mm, fall back to the bbox floor and say why. Finding and script: hub docs/titan/audit/cad (CAD-2, repro/cad-kind-roller.mjs). No special case for one file: a table of names in the test.

items.title: Another robot's code is not bound to this robot's lift and arm without asking (CAD-1)
items.brief: A BIOBUZZ OpMode (intake motor, outtake1 and outtake2 flywheels) on the default INTO THE DEEP robot binds outtake1 and outtake2 to the Outtake arm by a shared word (score 80 binds outright) and intake to the lift by elimination, with no question asked. Decision already made: elimination (only-one, src/bind.js about 282) is allowed only when another device was bound by strong evidence (spec, declaration or an exact name), and only when the way the code uses the device fits the joint: a joint with two finite limits needs position control (target positions, encoder reads, servo positions); a power-only or velocity motor never goes there. In autoMap.one() (src/mapping.js) a shared word counts only in the joint's own id or mate name, not in a carried part's path, and subsystem words (outtake, deposit) drop to the 55 tier. Otherwise ask, offering that candidate first. Finding and script: hub docs/titan/audit/cad (CAD-1, repro/cad-bind-elimination.mjs). Look at it in the page with the team's Meet0MainTeleOp on the default robot: the questions must read well.

items.title: The robot's collision shape follows its mechanisms (CAD-3)
items.brief: One fixed box from the drawn pose (Field.footprintOf, computed once in src/app.js) stands for the robot against walls, obstacles, robots and balls. The default robot reaches 680 x 450 mm with its intake out but collides as 465 x 450 mm always; a robot drawn extended collides as extended always. Precompute each joint's extreme points at setup (at most 26 per moving link); each tick pose them with jointValues and jointMove (the transforms robotSize in src/robotcheck.js already computes) and join them with the frame box, keeping ox and oy. Measured cost: 1 to 2 microseconds a tick. Payload mouths are in the footBox frame (AGENTS.md, Game pieces): they must not move when the box grows; check tests/payload.test.mjs. Finding and script: hub docs/titan/audit/cad (CAD-3, repro/cad-footprint.mjs). Needs the physics branch in first (stopAgainst changes there).

items.title: Mechanism motors feel load, gravity and inertia (PHY-3)
items.brief: Every non-drive motor ramps at a fixed 8 power units a second with no torque. Give each a one-degree-of-freedom state in stepDevices: J w' = motor torque - gravity - friction, J from the joint's parts (src/inertia.js) plus the rotor through its ratio, integrated implicitly. The flywheel model in src/payload.js (flyStep, flyParams) is the special case already in: fold it in. Existing tests pin timings to the old ramp: where a number changes, the commit says why the new one is right. Large: plan it, then build it in steps that each leave the suite green.
done_when: an arm past its motor's stall does not rise; a flywheel's time to 90 % is within 10 % of J w / tau ln 10
the full suite green with every changed expectation explained
reviewed, pushed, CI green

items.title: The battery sags under load (PHY-6)
items.brief: The voltage is a constant, so code that scales power by 12/V is never exercised. V = Voc - R times the sum of motor currents (R about 0.12 ohm), fed to the motor models each tick and read by the voltage sensor. Motor specs are quoted at 12 V: vScale should be volts/12, not volts/12.6. Let Monte Carlo vary Voc and R.
done_when: a four-motor launch dips below 11 V

items.title: A vendor part is weighed once, however many solids draw it (CAD-4)
items.brief: vendorMassFor (src/inertia.js about 136) matches one solid's own name and partMass gives every match the whole figure. On the default robot two Control Hubs drawn as two solids each weigh 1.080 kg (the table says at most 0.460) and four mecanum wheels drawn as 91 solids each weigh 0.358 kg by density (the table says 1.340). Group solids by the innermost sub-assembly node (solid.asm) or leaf occurrence that matches a vendor row; give the group the figure once, spread by hull volume; skip the per-solid test inside a matched group. Finding and script: hub docs/titan/audit/cad (CAD-4, repro/cad-vendor-mass.mjs).

items.title: A mate relation drives its follower the right way from either end (CAD-5)
items.brief: src/mates.js about 523: a relation's ratio ignores the sign s that mateTravel applies when the joint tree reaches a mate from its second end, so the same cascade lift described with the carriage mate's ends swapped moves its carriage -10 mm for +10 mm of stage; and followQ (src/jointspec.js about 84) never clamps a follower to its own limits. Store s on each mate joint; ratio = (reverse ? -1 : 1) * inv0 * inv1 * k * s_leader * s_follower, the same for rack-and-pinion and screw relations; clamp followQ to the follower's limits. Finding and script: hub docs/titan/audit/cad (CAD-5, repro/cad-relation-sign.mjs). No Onshape API calls: the generator's mated robot is the fixture.
done_when: both descriptions of the mated robot give the same ratio and the same world motion; a follower never leaves its limits

items.title: A missing file is a 404, not the page cached for a year
items.brief: Seen on the live site 2026-11-20: GET /engine-00000000.js answers 200 text/html (the app page) with Cache-Control: immutable, max-age one year, because Cloudflare Pages treats a site with no 404.html as a single-page app and the _headers rule for /engine-*.js still applies. A tab left open across a deploy that asks for the old engine file caches the page under that address; if a later deploy brings the same engine hash back, that browser has a broken worker for a year. Add a small 404.html to the build output (check first that nothing relies on the fallback: /terms, /privacy, /support and /fragment are real files; the Functions under /room, /onshape and /leaderboard are not affected) and make sure the 404 itself is not sent as immutable (look at the real headers on a branch preview before landing: https://<branch>.ftc-simbench-pro.pages.dev). Also make the page say "a new version is out, reload" when its worker file fails to load.
done_when: on the preview: a missing /engine-*.js is 404 and not cacheable for a year; /, /terms, /privacy, /support, /fragment still 200
